semantics.bitwise_or: Each output bit is OR of corresponding a and b bits.
semantics.logical_or: One when either input vector is nonzero; zero when both are zero.
semantics.inverse: out_not[5:3] is bitwise NOT b; out_not[2:0] is bitwise NOT a.
semantics.timing: Combinational, no added cycles or state; original specifies gates and no clock port.
semantics.reset: None; original interface has no reset.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization specified; outputs follow input values after combinational settling.

numeric.packing: b inverse upper half, a inverse lower half
numeric.arithmetic: Boolean operations only; no rounding, saturation or overflow.

verification.oracle_source: Original problem.txt gate descriptions and packing requirement
verification.binary_coverage: Exhaust all 8 x 8 binary input pairs using per-bit truth tables and nonzero comparisons.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs, wait 1 ns for combinational settling, compare with case inequality.
verification.four_state: Directed X/Z cases check conventional SystemVerilog OR/NOT behavior, as supplemental coverage.
verification.failure: $fatal on any mismatch and bounded timeout
verification.success: Explicit PASS line after all comparisons

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original does not explicitly describe unknown or high-impedance inputs.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use standard SystemVerilog bitwise and logical operator semantics; binary behavior is exhaustively checked.
